name: Weapons of Spirit
summary: Witch Doctor Uzer'i now has everything needed and the spirits you captured. Binding them into weapons is hard work, so Uzer'i asks you to wait a moment while the preparations are made.

sections.title: A Moment's Patience
sections.body: Uzer'i admits that imbuing weapons with muisek is hard going. Now holding all the materials needed, along with the spirits you captured, Uzer'i can begin, and asks you to wait while the weapons are prepared.

sections.title: When the Wait Ends
sections.body: Uzer'i returns and lets you choose from the weapons, telling you the spirits of the captured creatures are sealed into them for good. Their energy can now be wielded as your own.

faq.q: Who is behind Weapons of Spirit?
faq.answer: Witch Doctor Uzer'i, the same one who sent you after the muisek, and it comes after Mountain Giant Muisek.

faq.q: What does Witch Doctor Uzer'i do during this step?
aliases: what happens in weapons of spirit
faq.answer: Uzer'i works at imbuing the captured muisek into weapons, a process called difficult, and asks you to wait while the preparations are made.

faq.q: What is needed before Uzer'i can begin?
faq.answer: Uzer'i says the needed materials are gathered and the spirits you captured are in hand, so the work can start.

attribution: Classic quest text: Weapons of Spirit
